_comment: Rhythm stage desk check, shape world (synthetic traces only, no participants; .steering/20261015-rhythm-stage-speed-shape-world/design.md: copied from experiments/20261014-rhythm-stage-speed-confound-world/config.json (7d38df98), changed: ceiling.steps are f100 / f200 / d100 / d200 with their worlds in ceiling.worlds, pc_stall.lam and pc_stall.lam_1800 emptied, pc_r, split and compare added). The copied comment follows: Rhythm stage desk check, confound world (synthetic traces only, no participants; .steering/20261014-rhythm-stage-speed-confound-world/design.md: copied from experiments/20261014-rhythm-stage-graded-world/config.json (424d9500), changed: ceiling.steps are the widths c050 / c100 / c200, speed_confound added). The copied comment follows: graded world Copied from experiments/20261013-rhythm-stage-round2/config.json (d98103a0); this task changes only ceiling (the three steps and their rule), pc_stall.lam (a table per step, empty until the pilot of the step) and pc_stall.lam_1800 (new, the same) (.steering/20261014-rhythm-stage-graded-world/design.md 0, 1.2, 1.3 and 3.0). The graded world's STRUGGLE settings are made by gen_sessions.py from segments_v4 and segments_v2 (_comment_graded) and are not written here. Rhythm stage desk check, round 2 (synthetic traces only, no participants). Copied from experiments/20261012-rhythm-stage-desk-check/config.json (b2d02846); round 2 changes only sets.pilot (P 240, bootstrap 2000), pc_stall.pilot_grid (0.025 to 0.300), pc_stall.aim (new) and pc_stall.lam (written after the pilot) (.steering/20261013-rhythm-stage-round2/design.md 0, 1.2 and 3.9). Rhythm stage desk check (synthetic traces only, no participants). The generator settings (session, segments, segments_v2, transitions, keys, sets) and e13 are copied unchanged from experiments/20261010-portrait-eh1-round5/config.json; segments_v3, ceiling and speed are new (.steering/20261012-rhythm-stage-desk-check/design.md 1.5, 1.6 and 3.0).
_comment_segments_v2: Deviation after the freeze (design section 8, 2026-10-09): world v2 gives FLOW and STRUGGLE the same burst duration and pause distributions, and THINK and STALL_SILENT the same length, so that the stall regime shows only in corrections, key intervals and burst length, not in the presence pattern. Reason: in v1 the presence-only model reaches AUC 0.997, which leaves no room for the positive controls (E1-3 undecidable by construction).
_comment_segments_v3: design 1.6: world v3 = world v2 with two changes in STRUGGLE: flight_median_ms and flight_sigma as FLOW (150, 0.25), and world v1's pause after a backspace (p_pause_after_bs 0.6, pause_after_bs_min_ms 2000, pause_after_bs_extra_ms 3000, the values of segments.STRUGGLE). Everything else is as in segments_v2.
_comment_segments_v4: design 1.6 (researcher, decisions 16, after pilot 0 found no usable world): world v4 = world v2 with STRUGGLE's flight_median_ms and flight_sigma as FLOW (150, 0.25) and no pause after a backspace, so the key timing of FLOW and STRUGGLE is drawn alike; the stall regime shows only in the backspace rate (0.25 vs 0.03) and in the segment structure (lengths and transitions). Everything else is as in segments_v2.
_comment_ceiling: shape world design 1.2, 3.0: steps f100 / f200 (the factor world at c = 1 / 2) and d100 / d200 (the drift world); ceiling.worlds gives each step's world (gen_sessions.py --world). The rest as the copied comment: graded world design 3.0, kept by the confound world (steps = widths c; pilot 0, after the freeze, before any pilot 1): SEED + seed_offset, P sessions of each step in steps (the other sets at the smoke size, unused), AUC(A) and AUC(A_speed) per label and classifier, out of fold. A step is ceiling when both classifiers' L300 AUC(A_speed) are >= main_auc (equality is at the ceiling), unmeasured when a fit failed or a value is NaN, else go. Only go steps run the pilot 1, the smoke and the main run. The steps are not moved after pilot 0 (round 1 decisions 16). main_auc (round 1 design 3.2): in the main run and the pilot 1, a classifier whose AUC(A_speed) of a label is >= main_auc is at the ceiling and left out of every maximum of that label. Round 1 and 2's prefer and usable_max are removed.
_comment_speed: design 1.5: the five speed quantities of a span [s, e). Intervals are differences of consecutive press times inside the span (ms); quantities 2 and 3 use the intervals below short_ms; a run (quantity 4) continues while the interval is below run_ms; quantity 5 counts the presses of the final last_s seconds; at L60 model A_speed adds quantities 1 and 2 of the lags earlier windows (a window before the session start has 0 presses and quantity 2 = short_ms).
_comment_pc_stall: graded world design 1.2: lam and lam_1800 are tables per step (lam.<step>.<candidate>), written after the pilot of the step by checks.py --apply-pilot config.json results/<step>/pilot/pilot.json <step> (lam_1800.<step> is not written when the pilot's L1800 part stopped). The main run checks them against the step's pilot.json. Round 2 design 3.9: the pilot 1 (SEED + sets.pilot.seed_offset, sets.pilot.P sessions, L300, sets.pilot.bootstrap) runs [0] + pilot_grid; per candidate the lambdas with lower bound max > lower and point estimate max <= upper are in the band, and of those (else of all) the one whose isotonic point estimate is closest to aim wins (checks.select_lambda). A candidate with no finite point estimate stops the pilot. lam is written after the pilot by checks.py --apply-pilot. As round 1 (design 1.4, 3.2): the PC-stall of a candidate works when the lower bound of the max over the attackers > lower and the point estimate <= upper (and its PC0's upper < e13.margin). Round 1's target (0.05) is replaced by aim.
_comment_describe: design 3.4: stop events are gaps of event_s or longer; a change smaller than unchanged is 'unchanged'; the lag needs the crossing to hold for hold_s; Ridge alpha; GroupKFold folds; the time since the last press is capped at since_cap_s.
_comment_graded: graded world design 1.3: --world graded --t T copies segments_v4 and sets STRUGGLE's flight_median_ms = m4^(1-t) * m2^t and flight_sigma = (1-t) * s4 + t * s2 (m, s of segments_v4 and segments_v2: 150 / 320 ms, 0.25 / 0.35). t = 0 is v4 and t = 1 is v2 exactly.
_comment_speed_confound: confound world design 1.3: --world confound --c C uses the graded segments at base_t (the stall delta = ln(STRUGGLE's median / FLOW's median) = 0.5 ln(320 / 150) in log units) and draws every FLOW and STRUGGLE key interval inside a burst as lognormal(ln(median) + z(tau), sigma) with z(tau) = c * delta * (u + d(floor(tau / 1000 ms))): u ~ N(0, 1) per unit (a session or a pair), d a stationary unit Ornstein-Uhlenbeck series per second with time constant tau_s. The widths c of the steps are in ceiling.steps. Shape world design 1.2: --world factor keeps only u (z = c * delta * u) and --world drift only d (z = c * delta * d(k)); the draws of u and d do not depend on the world.
_comment_pc_r: shape world design 1.3: the r-side controls PCrl- (the PC-stall's block value as u_r, u_a = 0.5) and PCrv- (u_r = 0.5 + var_sd * value * e, e standard normal per point, u_a = 0.5), with PCrl0- / PCrv0- at lambda 0. pilot_grid (decisions 10): the PC-stall's grid and 0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.8 / 1.0 (at lambda 0.3 the pre-freeze trial left most controls below the band). lam is a table per step, lam.<step>.<level|var>.<candidate> = a value of pc_r.pilot_grid or null (no finite point estimate: never a stop), written by checks.py --apply-pilot from the pilot's L300r part (pc_stall's rule).
_comment_split: shape world design 1.4 (from experiments/20261015-rhythm-stage-speed-cause-split/config.json, 6599c5e4): after the main run, on the same rows, L300 only: the base models lr, hgb, lrbin (bins quantile bins of each A_speed column next to its value) with the stage groups in drops dropped; lrbin2 descriptive. The 72 names (candidates, PCs-, PC0-) take every drop; the 96 r-side controls take none / R2 with lr, hgb, lrbin (pcr_drops; with Rall a control's features are its lambda 0 baseline's, since its a does not depend on lambda: cross-review 1). The gate compares the no-drop lr and hgb values with this step's results/<step>/main/e13.json (gate_tol). read: as the cause split; pcr_upper is the upper end of the band of the r-side controls' reading (design 3.3 (j)).
_comment_compare: shape world design 1.5: compare.py reads this task's results and the files below (paths from experiments/, checked against their SHA-256 before reading) and writes results/compare/compare.json; pairs maps c to the confound world's step and this task's factor and drift steps.
